properties.text: [24] A source reporting on the Russian Western Grouping of Forces reported on August 10 that Russian forces unsuccessfully attacked near Petropavlivka (east of Kupyansk).[25] Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Borova direction on August 9 and 10 but did not advance.

The milblogger claimed that Russian forces seized Rai-Oleksandrivka (east of Slovyansk) and consolidated positions in Psykunivka (north of Rai-Oleksandrivka) but acknowledged that Ukraine’s frequent counterattacks have slowed Russian advances in the area.[32] The milblogger claimed that reports that Russian forces are attacking Mykolaivka (northwest of Rai-Oleksandrivka) are premature.

Lee assessed that Russian forces will use the waste heaps at the mine they seized east of Chernihivka (south of Dobropillya) as a hub for drone crews and infiltration groups as Russian forces build up their presence in nearby Bilytske (just east of Chernihivka) and Matyasheve (just west of Chernihivka).

Lee added that Russian forces advanced in Kucheriv Yar and Torske (both northeast of Dobropillya) after Russian forces in the area received reinforcements from the 228th and 239th motorized rifle regiments (both of the 90th Tank Division, 41st CAA, Central Military District [CMD]).

[44] Russian milbloggers claimed on August 10 that Russian forces advanced north and west of Myrne (northwest of Pokrovsk) and southwest of Novopidhorodne (southwest of Pokrovsk).[45] Russian forces continued limited offensive operations in the Novopavlivka direction on August 9 and 10 but did not advance.
Ukrainian forces recently advanced in the Kupyansk and Borova directions.

[38] A Russian milblogger claimed on August 8 that Russian forces advanced south of Novyi Donbas (southeast of Dobropillya).[39] Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Pokrovsk direction on August 7 and 8 but did not advance.

The Russian monthly rate of advance in July 2026 is higher than the rate of advance in June 2026 but is still insufficient to seize the remainder of Donetsk Oblast by Putin’s newly set deadline of December 31, 2026.[6] It remains highly unlikely that Russian forces will be able to seize the Fortress Belt or the rest of Donbas any time soon, if at all.

Russian milbloggers acknowledged on August 7 that Ukrainian forces control part of central Muravka (northeast of Novopavlivka).[44] Geolocated footage published on August 6 shows Ukrainian forces striking a Russian position north of Novomykolaivka (northeast of Novopavlivka), after what ISW assesses was a Russian infiltration mission.[45] Ukrainian forces recently advanced northeast of Oleksandrivka.
